title: rexxos_arbitrator: demands, a machine arbitrator and provision plans
purpose: Continuity for rexxos_arbitrator v0.1-dev4 and Tom Dyer's direction of 25 Nov 2026: the machine as states and triggers; provisioning (swap, RAM stores, caches) planned from demands by a per-machine arbitrator that asks the cluster for cross-arbitration. Architecture: Tom Dyer. Coding and writing: Claude (Opus 5.5).
